note: Ps39 introspective (corrected method). Guarded tongue/silence -> inner fire bursts (lev hot, hagig muse) -> mortality (yada know my end / man not know; days a breath) -> qavah/tocheleth wait+hope -> pesha/avon sin, scorn/fool -> tefillah/dimah prayer+tears. 2 God-acts (natsal Deliver, tigrah hostile hand) = qualifiers. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: my ways (that I not sin with my tongue)
'I will GUARD (shamar) my ways, that I may not sin with my tongue' — deliberate self-watchfulness over speech; shamar the resolve to police one's conduct, esp. the tongue, before the watching wicked
sin / miss the mark (chata - with the tongue)
guarded-against ('that I may NOT sin with my tongue')
'that I may not SIN (chata) with my tongue' — the specific fault guarded against; chata here of the tongue, the sin of speech David muzzles himself to avoid
my mouth (while the wicked is present)

'I will GUARD (shamar) my mouth with a muzzle, so long as the wicked are in my presence' — silence imposed on oneself before the wicked; shamar of the mouth, the second guarding, the self-muzzling that leads to the pent-up fire (v3)
'so long as the WICKED (rasha) are in my presence' — the wicked whose watching prompts David's silence; rasha here the reason for restraint — he will not give them occasion by rash speech

'My HEART (lev) became hot within me' — the suppressed emotion combusting under enforced silence; lev here the seat where pent feeling turns to fire, forcing speech at last — silence intensifies rather than quells the inner burning
the musing that kindles the heart's fire
'As I MUSED (hagig), the fire burned' — inner meditation feeding the flame; hagig = the murmuring reflection that, in the silence, stokes the heart until David must speak
know / make known (yada, hiphil - my end)
my end / the measure of my days
paired with knowing how fleeting he is
'O LORD, make me KNOW (yada) my end and the measure of my days' — the plea for a felt knowledge of mortality; yada here the wisdom to grasp one's own transience (first of the know-thread, v4x2, v6)
'let me KNOW (yada) how fleeting I am!' — the desire to internalise one's frailty; yada here the sobering self-knowledge of transience, the wisdom the whole psalm reaches for
know (yada - does not know who will gather)
negated ('does NOT know who will gather')

'man heaps up wealth and does not KNOW (yada) who will gather' — the futile ignorance of the striving mortal; yada negated (contrast v4's sought knowledge) — the man who will not know his transience toils in vain for heirs unknown
'And now, O LORD, for what do I WAIT (qavah)?' — the turn from mortality's despair to God; qavah (recurs Ps37) the waiting whose only object, amid life's vanity, is the LORD himself
'My HOPE (tocheleth) is in you' — the sole resting-place of expectation; tocheleth the hope fixed on God alone when all earthly striving is shown to be breath
God asked to deliver from them (v8)

'Deliver me from all my TRANSGRESSIONS (pesha)' — the sins David begs to be freed from; pesha (recurs Ps32) the rebellions from which he seeks deliverance (God's delivering = its qualifier), lest he become the fool's scorn
deprecated ('Do NOT make me the scorn of the fool')

'Do not make me the SCORN (cherpah) of the fool!' — the dread of being mocked by the godless; cherpah (recurs Ps22:6, 31:11) the reproach David fears if unforgiven, the shame of the disciplined believer before the fool
'the scorn of the FOOL (nabal)' — the godless fool whose mockery David dreads; nabal (as Ps14:1 'the fool says no God') the senseless one whose contempt would compound the sufferer's shame
paired with what is dear consumed

'When you discipline a man with rebukes for SIN (avon), you consume like a moth what is dear' — sin as the ground of the chastening; avon here the iniquity for which God's discipline (his hostile hand, v10, the qualifier) eats away what one treasures — man is a mere breath
be dear / desirable (chamad - what is dear to him)

'you consume like a moth what is DEAR (chamad) to him' — the treasured thing the discipline eats away; chamad (usually 'covet/desire', Ps19:10) here the man's cherished possessions dissolving like moth-eaten cloth, the vanity of what mortals prize

'Hear my PRAYER (tefillah), O LORD... hold not your peace at my tears' — the appeal of the sojourner; tefillah (recurs Ps17:1) the prayer offered with weeping by one who is a guest on earth, as all his fathers were
'hold not your peace at my TEARS (dimah)' — the weeping that accompanies the prayer; dimah the tears of the transient sojourner, which he begs God not to meet with silence

v8 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'DELIVER (natsal) me from all my transgressions' — God's delivering is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE David appeals to for freedom from his sins — captured as a qualifier of pesha (v8).
hostility / blow of the hand (tigrah - God's)
the disciplining hand behind the affliction for sin (v10-11)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'I am spent by the HOSTILITY (tigrah) of your hand' — God's chastening hand is not a human IB char; it is the SOURCE consuming David under discipline for sin — captured as a qualifier of avon (v11).
v12: 'give ear to my CRY (shav'ah)' - David's cry, joined to his prayer (278048); captured as a qualifier/coupling of the prayer. Qualifier.
the hearing sought for the prayer (v12)
v12 QUALIFIER (God's act sought): 'HEAR (shama) my prayer' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; it grounds/answers David's prayer (278048). Qualifier.
give ear / attend (azan - God asked to attend)
the attending sought for the cry (v12)
v12 QUALIFIER (God's act sought): 'GIVE EAR (azan) to my cry' - God's attending is not a human IB char; it grounds the answered prayer (278048). Qualifier.
be silent / deaf (charash - God asked not to, negated)
God's silence deprecated re David's tears (v12)
v12 QUALIFIER (God's act, negated): 'hold not your PEACE (charash) at my tears' - God's silence (deprecated) is not a human IB char; it qualifies the plea over David's tears (278053). Qualifier.
v2: 'I held my peace to no AVAIL (tov / good)' - the benefit the silence failed to yield; an outcome-word (the futility of the restraint), not itself an inner operation. Standalone.

v2: 'my DISTRESS (keeb) grew worse' - the pain intensifying under the enforced silence; the affliction-state that drives the heart to burn (v3). Standalone/condition (the IB movement is the heart's fire, 278073).
v2: distress 'GREW WORSE (akar)' - the worsening/stirring of the pain; a change-of-state verb qualifying the distress, not itself an inner operation. Standalone.
fleeting / transient (chadel - how fleeting I am)
v4: 'let me know how FLEETING (chadel) I am' - the transience David wants to grasp; the object of the knowing (278088), the frailty-fact, not itself an inner operation. Standalone.
shadow / image (tselem - man goes about as a shadow)

v6: 'man goes about as a SHADOW (tselem)' - the transience-image of human life; a metaphor of mortality's insubstantiality, not an inner operation. Standalone (grounds the vanity-theme the knowing v4 reaches for).
brighten / recover cheer (balag - that I may smile again)

v13: 'Look away from me, that I may SMILE (balag) again, before I depart' - the momentary brightening/recovery of cheer David asks for before death; a wished-for lightening, closely tied to the plea. Standalone (the plea itself is carried by prayer/tears, 278048/278053).
